cues_sha256: <the SHA-256 of the cues.json this map was written against; conform.py refuses any other list>
fields: sections[].id names a section of the cue list, whose bounds come from the list and are never repeated here; take_start: seconds into the music take where the section begins; edits: further entry points inside the section, at film seconds from the section's start; xfade_ms: the crossfade at each seam; gain_db: the music gain for the section, applied once
